(1) The variability of FinFET devices for mm wave applications, both in the DC and in the AC domain, is a critical issue that must be addressed to guarantee the reliability of the device and of the circuit; (2) The temperature and bias dependent variability analysis, performed by a numerically efficient TC- AD approach, is an effective way to predict and mitigate this variability.

The variability analysis of FinFET devices for mm waves applications, based on a numerically efficient TCad model, shows the need to improve the FinFET thermal design, to mitigate the impact of doping or geometric variations on the device performances.

(i) the FinFET thermal resistance can be as high as 200 K/W and that (ii) the insertion loss and the bandwidth of a FinFET mm wave amplifier are highly sensitive to the doping and geometric variability.
